description: pixel art landscape, a quiet forest pond at dawn: still dark water with lily pads, reeds along the shore and a small wooden fishing pier with a wicker fish basket, willows leaning over the water, thin ice-blue glowing crystal shards between the reeds and faint luminous blue lines on the water, soft mist, wide panorama for a dim background behind text, low contrast, muted dark palette of deep greens and blues with ice-blue accents, no text, no border, no people, no animals
